summary: Fix the Production favicon full-rebuild runtime so progress visibly advances instead of appearing stuck at 0/N. Rebuild now processes one item per browser-assisted step, uses bounded quick resolution during full rebuild, safely recovers abandoned web-owned icon jobs only when the maintenance lock is free, counts failed items correctly across IconCache/JobManager result keys, and keeps the step alive across browser disconnects. No schema, provider architecture, SVG validator, updater mechanism, or Production write.
